messages:
kyla: Thanks for the all-hands today. Customers pinged asking for a short scoping doc: SOC2/ISO status, VPC private control plane capabilities (peering, endpoints, SSO), audit log detail & retention, and KMS/BYOK rotation behavior. Can we do quick owners + timelines?

sec-bot: Uploaded slides + trackers: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/brief. Office-hours RSVP: https://cal.com/redwood/security-officehours.

omar: Quick rundown: SOC2 Type II audit window target = Oct-Nov 2026; controls in place by Aug 2026. ISO readiness assessment planned Q3; cert target H1 2027. We'll publish the controls mapping and evidence checklist next week.

liz: Audit logs v1 fields: ts, service, model_id, model_version, request_id, route, token_in, token_out, latency_ms, actor_id. Hosted default: prompts redacted/truncated in Console exports (90d). Private: full payload export to customer buckets; retention controlled by customer. Example event: ```{"ts":"2026-09-10T12:00:00Z","service":"inference","model_id":"redwood-13b","model_version":"v2.3","request_id":"req_0XYZ","token_in":12}```

infra_kai: VPC private control plane beta = mid-July for a small cohort. Features: VPC endpoints, cross-account peering (IAM role trust required), and private DNS. Beta docs will include peering checklist and SG/route guidance. Note: watch inter-region egress costs.

kyla: KMS/BYOK: Private supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) now. We use envelope encryption; rotation supported via customer KMS + our rekey API. HSM-backed BYOK planned as limited alpha in Q4. We'll publish a rotation playbook with expected steps and impacts (cache rewraps, short window for rekey).

omar: Two clarifications: 1) Will hosted opt-in allow full prompt export? 2) Will logs include model_hash/quant_profile for exact repro?

liz: Hosted opt-in: yes, only with explicit admin consent + data retention settings, and for some regulated customers a signed addendum. Model provenance: schema v2 will add model_hash and quant_profile; target this quarter. For now model_version + model_id + release notes should map to artifacts.

sec-bot: Tasks created: [soc2-controls-map], [audit-log-schema], [vpc-beta-checklist], [byok-rotation-playbook], [office-hours]. Will ping owners tomorrow at 10:00 UTC.

kyla: Action owners confirmed: @omar SOC2 doc, @liz audit logs + sales 1-pager, @infra_kai VPC checklist, @kyla BYOK playbook. I'll review drafts. DM me for VPC beta candidate list.

kyla: Thanks everyone 44d. We'll consolidate and post the customer-ready FAQ before the office hours.
